title: Defer nonessential enhancements until strict-port MVP
abstract: Keep redesigns and optional post-MVP features outside the strict porting phase until the agreed MVP is reached, unless a separately authorized exception changes scope.

source.reference: Generalized project-management and strict-porting proposal; private drafting text not retained

scope_hints.trigger: enhancement work is proposed during a strict port

unresolved: Define explicit pre-MVP change authorization and applicable exceptions.
remarks: Proposed atomic rule only. Group membership is non-normative; no processing, task creation, rule publication or application is authorized by intake.
